details: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are reportedly traveling to Pakistan to resume talks on the Iran conflict, coinciding with the arrival of Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in Islamabad. This diplomatic push follows President Trump's extension of a ceasefire between the US and Iran. While traditional markets have shown indecision amid the ambiguity of diplomacy versus escalation, cryptocurrencies have previously demonstrated varied responses to developments in the ongoing US-Iran situation, with positive movements on hopes for de-escalation and drops during increased tensions. The extension of the ceasefire and resumption of talks suggest a move towards de-escalation, which has historically been met with cautious optimism in crypto markets, despite Bitcoin sometimes being classified as a high-risk asset in the short term during crises.
title: US Envoys Head to Pakistan for Iran Negotiations Amid Ceasefire Extension
